overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation where the commission discussed an unlisted letter because the chair could not reasonably have anticipated it 48 hours before the meeting; the wetlands notice-procedure claim was declined as outside the OML.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the commission discussed and acted on a letter-based wetlands order amendment at its October 23, 2012 meeting, a topic not listed on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing the letter at its October 23, 2012 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the commission failed to follow required procedures for publishing notice of amendments to wetlands Orders of Condition before considering a request.
allegations.key_passage: The Division of Open Government only enforces and interprets the Open Meeting Law, therefore we decline to review this allegation.
